2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **FreeLang Nano-Kernel**: ARM64 베어메탈 부팅, 4계층 아키텍처

   - **ARM64 Context**: X0-X30 (31개 레지스터), SP_EL0/EL1, ELR_EL1, SPSR_EL1

   - **BCM2711 GPIO**: 0xFE200000, 28핀, Input/Output/Alt

   - **ThreatClassifier 앙상블**: 0.6×NN + 0.3×규칙 + 0.1×이상치
   - **FreeLang 내장 암호 함수**: `sha256()`, `hmac()`, `base64_encode()`
   - **BehavioralAnalyzer N-gram**: 슬라이딩 윈도우, bigram/trigram/fourgram 이상치

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **Nano-Kernel 생성 파일들**:

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/boot/arm64_entry.fl` (360줄)

     - `PageAllocator.free_page(addr: u64) -> bool`
     - `validate_pool_integrity()`, `validate_page_addr()`, `validate_page_alignment()`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/boot/mod.fl`
     - `pub mod arm64_entry; pub mod nano_memory;` - nano_memory로 수정 (기존 memory_init 대체)

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/core/nano_task.fl` (400줄)
     - `TaskState { Ready, Running, Blocked, Zombie }`, `Arm64Context { x: [u64; 31], sp_el0, sp_el1, elr_el1, spsr_el1 }`
     - `NanoTask { tid, state, context, stack_base, priority }`, `TaskManager`, `ContextSwitcher`
     - `ContextSwitcher.switch_context()` - 5µs 시뮬레이션

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/core/nano_scheduler.fl` (350줄)
     - `SchedulingPolicy { RoundRobin, PriorityBased, Cooperative }`
     - `NanoScheduler { ready_queue: Vec<u32>, current_tid: u32 }`
     - `schedule_next()`, `yield_current()`, `remove_task()`
     - `PriorityQueueScheduler { priority_queues: [Vec<u32>; 256] }`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/core/arm64_exception.fl` (300줄)
     - `ExceptionType { SyncEl1, IrqEl1, FiqEl1, ErrorEl1, SyncEl0, IrqEl0, FiqEl0, ErrorEl0 }`
     - `SyscallNumber { SysWrite=0, SysRead=1, SysAlloc=2, SysFree=3, SysFork=4, SysExit=5, SysLcdDraw=6, SysLcdFlush=7 }`
     - `ExceptionFrame { esr_el1, far_el1, elr_el1, x0-x7, sp, spsr_el1 }`
     - `ExceptionHandler.dispatch_exception()`, `handle_syscall()`, `VectorTable.set_handler()`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/hal/uart_driver.fl` (350줄)
     - `UART0_BASE: u64 = 0xFE201000u64` (BCM2711 PL011)
     - `UartDriver { state: UartState, tx_buffer, rx_buffer }`, `init() -> bool`
     - `send_byte(u8) -> bool`, `recv_byte() -> Option<u8>`, `throughput() -> u64`
     - `BufferedUart { tx_ring: [u8; 256], rx_ring: [u8; 256] }`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/hal/framebuffer.fl` (350줄)
     - `Color { r, g, b, a }`, `to_rgba8888() -> u32`
     - `FramebufferDriver { state: FramebufferState, frame_count, render_latency_us }`
     - `set_pixel(x, y, color) -> bool`, `clear(color) -> bool`, `flush() -> bool`
     - `get_fps() -> f32` (60.0 시뮬레이션), `DoubleBufferedFramebuffer`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/hal/gpio_driver.fl` (250줄)
     - `GPIO_BASE: u64 = 0xFE200000u64` (BCM2711)
     - `GpioMode { Input=0, Output=1, Alt0=4, Alt1=5 }`
     - `GpioDriver.set_mode(pin, mode) -> bool`, `write(pin, high) -> bool`, `read(pin) -> Option<bool>`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/services/nano_shell.fl` (400줄)
     - `ShellCommand { Help, Mem, Tasks, Reboot, Echo, Gpio, Dvfs, Unknown }`
     - `NanoShell.parse_command(&str) -> Option<ShellCommandArgs>`
     - `NanoShell.execute_command(args) -> ShellResult`
     - `InteractiveShell.add_char(u8) -> bool` (엔터 시 true)

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/src/services/ai_watchdog.fl` (350줄)
     - `DvfsState { P0=2000MHz, P1=1500MHz, P2=1200MHz, P3=800MHz, P4=200MHz }`
     - `AiWatchdog { dvfs_state, thermal: ThermalState, autonomous_decisions }`
     - `make_autonomous_decision() -> DvfsState` - 온도/CPU 기반 P-state 결정
     - `ThermalState.should_throttle() -> bool` (> 80°C 시 true)

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-nano-kernel/tests/nano_kernel_tests.fl`
     - 30개 무관용 테스트: A1-A6, M1-M6, B1-B6, C1-C6, D1-D6, E1-E6
     - `run_all_tests() -> Vec<TestResult>`
     - E1: 전체 부팅, E2: 메모리 스트레스 (256 pages), E3: 8개 멀티태스킹, E4: UART+FB 동시 I/O, E5: AI 열관리, E6: 최종 검증 (8/8 규칙)

   **FL-Signal 탐색에서 발견된 재사용 파일들**:

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-neural-kernel-integration/src/l0_engine/l0_neural_net.fl`
     - `L0NeuralNet { w1: [[f32; 16]; 16], b1: [f32; 16], w2: [[f32; 8]; 16], b2: [f32; 8] }`
     - `forward(&[f32; 16]) -> [f32; 8]` (< 10µs), `initialize_random()`, `update_weights()`
     - FL-Signal 재사용: 신호 이상 탐지 (Jamming/Spoofing/Replay 분류)

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-neural-kernel-integration/src/threat_engine/zero_copy_pipeline.fl`
     - `ZeroCopyRingBuffer { buffer: Vec<Option<RingBufferEvent>>, write_idx, read_idx, capacity: 4096 }`

     - `ZeroCopyPipeline { ring_buffer, batch_size: 32 }`, `process_batch() -> Vec<RingBufferEvent>`
     - FL-Signal 재사용: 무복사 P2P 신호 전송 버스

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-os-kernel/src/security/threat_classifier.fl`
     - 앙상블: `0.6 × nn_confidence + 0.3 × rule_confidence + 0.1 × anomaly_score`
     - FL-Signal 재사용: 신호 신뢰도 앙상블 계산

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-os-kernel/src/security/behavioral_analyzer.fl`
     - `NgramExtractor { per_pid_windows: HashMap<u32, Vec<u8>>, ngram_counts, normal_baseline }`
     - FL-Signal 재사용: 신호 시퀀스 이상 탐지 (채널 ID → pid, 신호 타입 코드 → syscall_id)

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-os-kernel/src/audit/hash_chain.rs`
     - `AuditEntry { previous_hash, current_hash }`, `compute_hash()`, `verify()`
     - FL-Signal 재사용: ZKP commitment chain

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-v4/examples/crypto.fl`
     - FreeLang 내장: `sha256(text)`, `hmac(message, secret)`, `base64_encode(data)`
     - FL-Signal 재사용: ZKP 해시 기반 commitment `H(secret || nonce)`

   - `/data/data/com.termux/files/home/freelang-ssh/src/client-v3-phase4.fl`
     - AES-256-GCM 패턴, HKDF-SHA256 키 유도, HMAC-SHA256 MAC 계산
     - FL-Signal 재사용: AES 암호화 뼈대

     - 해결: `Bash touch` 명령으로 파일 생성 후 `Read` 도구로 읽은 다음 `Write` 사용.
   - **mod.fl 기존 내용 충돌**: `boot/mod.fl`에 기존에 `memory_init` 참조가 있었음.

   - **테스트 파일 인서트**: 기존 테스트 파일에 새 그룹 추가 시 `run_all_tests()` 위에 삽입 패턴 사용.

   - **FL-Signal 탐색**: 2개 에이전트 병렬 실행으로 암호화 패턴 + Phase 8 재사용 패턴을 동시 탐색.
